component.name: Shelly-Qt
component.summary: Qt front end for the Shelly Arch Linux package manager

description.p: Shelly-Qt is a PySide6 desktop front end for Shelly (Shelly-ALPM). It searches and manages repo packages, the AUR, Flatpak apps, AppImages and prefix.dev packages by driving the shelly command line tool, which must be installed on the system.
